description: Create or replace one workflow secret on a repository, used in workflows as ${{ secrets.NAME }}. The name is saved upper-cased (cron_secret → CRON_SECRET); trailing spaces/newlines are removed from the value. The value is WRITE-ONLY: it is encrypted at rest and never returned, logged or audited — the result names the secret only. Pass expected_updated_at (the updated_at you last read) to update only if nobody changed it since: a newer value is never overwritten (error 'conflict'), a deleted secret is not re-created (error 'missing'). Setting the value it already has writes nothing (result 'unchanged'), so a retry is safe. Needs admin access to the repository and 'repo' scope. Audit-logged (name only). Returns {repository, name, created, result: 'created'|'updated'|'unchanged', updated_at}.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional ISO time: only update if the secret's updated_at is still this (from gluecron_list_repo_secrets)

name.description: Secret name: letters, digits, underscores; not starting with a digit

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_set_repo_secret
